findings.title: files.test.ts lacks renamed-duplicate fixture
findings.problem: Spec § Testing requires files.test.ts to be extended with both path-shaped and `name (2).ext` fixtures. The diff adds only 'artifacts/t1/closed_positions_analysis.xlsx' and 'artifacts/t1/'; there is no `report (2).csv`-style download-name case for the encoded-link anchor path.
findings.impact: A required spec testing item is only partially met: the saved-file name for a renamed duplicate (AC2) is not pinned on the files.ts download site, so a regression where chip label and saved name diverge for `name (n).ext` would go uncaught there.
findings.recommendation: Add a files.test.ts case using the existing downloadAnchorFor helper, e.g. downloadAnchorFor('artifacts/t1/report (2).csv') expecting anchor.download === 'report (2).csv', so the encoded-link download path is pinned for the `name (2).ext` shape as spec § Testing requires.
